blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Budget carrier Cebu Pacific said on Friday that it canceled Manila-Riyadh flights and vice versa to ensure the safety of passengers amid an ongoing security situation in the Middle East. In an advisory, Cebu Pacific provided the schedule with canceled flights, as of Friday, 1 p.m.: October 9: October 10: October 11: October 12: October 13: “Cebu Pacific (CEB) continues to closely monitor and assess developments in the Middle East amid the ongoing security situation in the region. The safety and well-being of our passengers and crew remain our priority,” it said. READ: PH carriers adjust more Middle […]...
